summary.headline: SaVida Health secures $412K in annual savings; $358K already locked in through EMR renegotiation
summary.narrative: Treya Partners partnered with SaVida Health to optimize spend across five critical categories. The engagement has delivered $357,889 in fully-executed annual savings by renegotiating the Athena EMR contract, while an additional $54,176 is in the final stages of validation across GPO, IT hardware, and telecom initiatives. Key wins include signing a Provista GPO agreement for medical and office supplies and consolidating telecom services with Comcast. Further savings are expected once GPO compliance is confirmed and telecom contracts are executed.
